title: Larkspur Personal Umbrella Policy Term Premium Rating Rule
content:
**Rating rule.** The term premium of a Larkspur Personal Umbrella Policy is the tier's base annual premium, plus the tier's additional vehicle premium for each vehicle above the tier's included vehicles, plus the tier's youthful driver premium for each youthful driver, plus the tier's rental unit premium for each rental unit above the tier's included rental units, plus the tier's watercraft premium for each watercraft.

Every rate named in the rule is the figure in the umbrella's own tier column of the rate pages.

## The rule broken into its parts

| Part of the term premium | Charged on | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| Base | The household, once | The base annual premium |
| Vehicles | Each vehicle above the included vehicles; nothing when the vehicle count is at or below the included count | The additional vehicle premium for each such vehicle |
| Youthful drivers | Every youthful driver rated, from the first | The youthful driver premium for each |
| Rental units | Each rental unit above the included rental units; nothing when the unit count is at or below the included count | The rental unit premium for each such unit |
| Watercraft | Every watercraft scheduled, from the first | The watercraft premium for each |

The term premium is the total of the five parts. A count at or below the included figure never produces a negative amount; it produces nothing for that part.

## Worked examples (hypothetical households)

**Example 1, Larkspur Umbrella 2M.** Hypothetical household: 3 vehicles, 1 youthful driver, no rental units, 1 watercraft. On the 2M rate column: base annual premium $392.00; one vehicle above the 2 included vehicles at $62.00; one youthful driver at $131.00; no rental unit charge; one watercraft at $55.00. The term premium is $392.00 plus $62.00 plus $131.00 plus $55.00, a total of $640.00.

**Example 2, Larkspur Umbrella 4M.** Hypothetical household: 2 vehicles, no youthful driver, 3 rental units, no watercraft. On the 4M rate column: base annual premium $613.00; no vehicle charge, since 2 vehicles are within the 2 included; two rental units above the 1 included unit at $66.00 each, $132.00; no youthful driver or watercraft charge. The term premium is $613.00 plus $132.00, a total of $745.00.

**Example 3, Larkspur Umbrella 10M.** Hypothetical household: 3 vehicles, no other exposures. The 10M base includes 3 vehicles, so no vehicle charge applies and the term premium is the base annual premium of $1184.00.

## Points of judgement

- Youthful drivers and watercraft have no included count: each one rated or scheduled is charged.
- Vehicles and rental units are charged only for the number above the tier's included count.
